ca.title: Install the Portunus certificate on devices
ca.lead: sing-box profiles and subscriptions already trust it. For other apps, install the CA once on each device; server certificates renew automatically.
ca.qr: Scan with the phone to download
ca.qrOff: A code for the phone appears once subscriptions are on: set their port in Settings.
ca.iosSteps:
Download the certificate on the iPhone or iPad: scan the code or open the file.
Open Settings and tap Profile Downloaded at the top.
Tap Install and enter the device passcode.
Go to Settings, General, About, Certificate Trust Settings.
Turn on full trust for the certificate: its name is shown above.
ca.androidSteps:
Download the certificate on the phone: scan the code or open the file.
Open Settings and go to Security.
Open Encryption & credentials (on some phones: More security settings).
Tap Install a certificate and choose CA certificate.
Confirm the warning and pick the downloaded file.
ca.androidNote: sing-box apps (Hiddify, NekoBox) ignore user-installed certificates: use a subscription or a regular link with them.
ca.windowsSteps:
Download the .cer file and open it.
Click Install Certificate.
Choose Local Machine and confirm.
Select Place all certificates in the following store and click Browse.
Choose Trusted Root Certification Authorities and finish the wizard.
ca.macosSteps:
Download the .crt file and open it: Keychain Access starts.
Add the certificate to the System keychain.
Find the certificate in the list by the name shown above and open it with a double click.
Expand Trust and set When using this certificate to Always Trust.
Close the window and enter your password.
